capabilities: Run external coding agents on vault notes
Create and manage projects with reusable context
Save and run reusable prompt commands
Ask about a selection inline with Quick Ask
disambiguation: Not a built-in model or chat-only assistant; it wraps external CLI agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex) that run as local processes.
extras: Agent is desktop-only because its backends run local processes; Quick Chat, Commands, and Quick Ask work on mobile. Free OpenCode Zen models carry a warning that the provider may log or train on prompts. Plugin frontend is open source; hosted backend is closed source. 14-day refund on paid plans.
problem: General chat assistants cannot inspect, edit, and act on the files in an Obsidian vault across multiple steps.

requires.name: OpenCode, Claude Code, or Codex CLI
Copilot Plus license for hosted models and preview features

summary: AI agent plugin that runs OpenCode, Claude Code, or Codex inside the vault for multi-step research, writing, and knowledge work.
